## sub-post-cards-to-ocr
The shared POST-one-card-to-contacts-from-ocr sub-workflow the plan calls for -- "the SMS-photo loop and watcher's Python heredoc reimplement the same 'upload crops, POST each card, tally created/failures' logic independently" was the old problem; since watcher/ is retired outright rather than ported, this is really "build it once, correctly" for the sole remaining caller (pipeline-process-cards-sms) rather than reconciling two drifted copies -- but the same discipline applies: one clear place this logic lives, reusable if locate-cards (dormant, lowest priority per the plan) ever gets a real caller.

Mirrors postExtractedCards' per-card POST body exactly, including the optional-field spreading (croppedImagePath/inboundMessageId/source only included when actually present, matching agent.mjs's own conditional spread) and the alreadyProcessed short-circuit contacts-from-ocr itself provides (a retried photo's already-created card re-derives the same sourceImageHash and no-ops instead of duplicating).

The "Supabase Service Role (n8n)" credential is the same one built in Stage 2 for contacts-from-note (Authorization: Bearer <service-role-key> only) -- contacts-from-ocr uses the identical isServiceRoleCall() auth check, so it is reused as-is here, not a new credential definition.

Not tagged skill-sandboxed -- this sub-workflow never calls Anthropic and holds no AI-facing credential; the credential-scoping concern check-n8n-credential-scopes.mjs audits (a skill session reaching more than its declared Anthropic-only scope) does not apply to a deterministic HTTP-POST helper.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 4). No credential is actually attached -- n8n instance has zero credentials configured, see n8n/README.md.
